2025-06-02.name: Da Yuan Hun
2025-06-02.desc:
As demonic forces run rampant and heretical paths prevail, countless lives are plunged into misery. In this era of chaos, a mysterious stone descends upon the world, transforming into the enlightened Stone Monkey, burdened with the mission to save all living beings. Bound by the cycle of cause and effect, he must once again face his ancient foe. Will he defy fate and rewrite his destiny, or fall into darkness? This is the origin of Sun Wukong's rise as a legendary great demon. The soul of the ape is about to awaken.

source: themoviedb.org

2025-06-05.name: Shixiong A Shixiong 4
2025-06-05.desc: The fourth season of Shixiong A Shixiong.

2025-06-06.name: Mattaku Saikin no Tantei to Kitara
2025-06-06.desc:
Once a legendary detective, Nagumo Keiichirou now stumbles through middle age baffled by smartphones and modern life. His quiet decline gets disrupted when Mashiro, a bold high school girl, bursts into his office demanding to become his apprentice. Though he's rusty and set in his ways, her relentless enthusiasm drags him back into detective work. Now the gap-bridging detective duo is on the case!

Source: Crunchyroll

Note: The first two episodes received an advance release on Kadokawa's YouTube channel on 6 June 2025. The regular TV broadcast started on 1 July 2025.

2025-06-06.name: Osomatsu-san (2025)
2025-06-06.desc:
* Based on the Osomatsu-kun gag manga series by Akatsuka Fujio.

Note: The first episode received an early screening at a special event on 6 June 2025 at Westa Kawagoe in Kawagoe and additional venues across Japan and was also streamed on Mixch. The regular TV broadcast started on 9 July 2025.

2025-06-10.name: Ke Jin Wanjia
2025-06-10.desc:
In the future world, the virtual game "Epoch" developed by Chu Group has attracted worldwide attention for its perfect immersive experience. However, on the eve of the game's official launch, the game developers Chu and his wife disappeared mysteriously. In order to find clues about the whereabouts of his parents, the rich young man Chu Yi, under the guidance of the humanoid AI Chaos, spent 30 billion krypton gold to enter the game upgrade adventure. In the process, Chu Yi gathered a group of player partners who fought side by side. After several efforts, he finally found out that his parents' disappearance was related to the Fantasy World Organization.

In order to find the whereabouts of his parents, fight against the Fantasy World Organization, and "save" the Era World, Chu Yi launched a series of ridiculous and unimaginable krypton gold operations, embarked on a journey of playing the pig and eating the tiger, and a wonderful battle between good and evil began.

source: MAL

2025-06-12.name: Yujin Xingzhe
2025-06-12.desc:
A village boy’s dream to join the elite Hell Hunters turns into a citywide crisis when he unknowingly aids an enemy operative. As a powerful villain sends forces to recover stolen data, a single act of kindness sets off a deadly chain of events that threatens the fate of Ember City.

source: themoviedb.org

2025-06-12.name: Zhu Xian 3
2025-06-12.desc:
The Beast God is born, blood bathing the world, Daoxuan stands up to fight, the forces of good and evil usher in a huge change, Gui Li and Xueqi once again stand at the intersection of fate. After the catastrophe, people's hearts and artifacts are both on the verge of being shattered...

source: MAL

2025-06-13.name: Kamitsubaki-shi Kensetsuchuu.
2025-06-13.desc:
Seven years after humanity was devastated by a major disaster, a beacon of science and prosperity rises in Kamitsubaki City. But lurking in its shadows are Tesseractor, monsters born from human darkness. Only the Witchling, five girls with voices that wield magic, stand against them. With every note, they fight, not just to protect the peace of the city, but to heal a broken world.

Source: Crunchyroll

Note: Episodes 0 and 1 received a theatre release starting on 13 June 2025. The regular TV broadcast started on 3 July 2025 with episode 0.

2025-06-13.name: Xian Chong
2025-06-13.desc:
One hundred years ago, in the battle of Mirage Land, the fairy Tianjuan killed the Lord of Mirage with her own hands. However, Tianjuan's soul was incomplete and she lost her memory of the war.

After the war, Tianjuan came down to earth and to serve as the landowner in Cangshuo. She adopted the fairy pet Li Xiao, which looked like a little black bird. Then the war goddess and the little black bird teamed up to solve a case. Behind a series of strange murders, they found traces of the mirage monster returning to the land of Cangshuo! As Li Xiao transforms, Tianjuan discovers that there is a possible connection between her dead lover Shao Weili, Li Xiao, and the Lord of Mirage whom she killed...

source: MAL

2025-06-14.name: Pyramid Game
2025-06-14.desc: "The class of happiness" Excellent students, a studious atmosphere, where Harin Baek reigns supreme. However, upon her arrival, Suzy Song discovers with horror that every last Thursday of the month "the Pyramid Game" takes place: a popularity vote where the least favored receives an "F" and becomes the target of school bullying. Selfishness, scheming, games of deception, will Suzy succeed in abolishing this pernicious system?

2025-06-14.name: Shenguo Zhi Shang
2025-06-14.desc:
The animation is adapted from the novel of the same name. It tells the story of Ning Changjiu, a young Taoist priest who failed to ascend to heaven in his previous life and was reborn 12 years ago. With the help of his beloved concubines, such as Lu Jiajia from the Yujian Sect and Zhao Xianger, the Queen of Zhao, he embarks on a passionate adventure to uncover a thousand-year-old conspiracy.

source: baike.baidu.com/googletranslate

2025-06-15.name: Mo Tian Ji
2025-06-15.desc:
What will happen when a desperate boy who grew up among evil people steps into the world of cultivating immortals? Immortals and demons can be separated by a thought, and life and death are not decided by heaven. Let's see how he goes against the current in this world where humans and demons coexist and evil spirits run rampant, and become a legend.

source: MAL

2025-06-20.name: Kimetsu no Yaiba: Hashira Geiko Hen - Tokubetsu Henshuuban
2025-06-20.desc:
Compilation TV Special of the Hashira Geiko Hen (Hashira Training Arc) (all 8 episodes) with new eyecatches, end credits scenes and next episode previews.

The compilation is broken into 2 parts:
1. 開幕編 (Kaimakuhen), episodes 1-4
2. 柱結集編 (Hashira Kesshuu Hen), episodes 5-8

2025-06-20.name: Lupin the IIIrd: Zenigata to Futari no Lupin

2025-06-25.name: Shinsei Galverse
2025-06-25.desc:
Zero crash-lands on the war-torn planet Amatera with no memories and no idea who she is. Amidst a brutal conflict between the local resistance and the imperial Gevuran forces, she meets Ring, a charismatic young leader fighting to save the world. As Zero's identity slowly awakens, she discovers she's no ordinary girl—she's a cosmic being known as Galverse, a key to something far greater than any one planet.

Source: Galverse

2025-06-27.name: Eiga Kobayashi-san Chi no Maidragon: Samishigariya no Ryuu
2025-06-27.desc: * Based on a seinen manga written and illustrated by Cool Kyoushinja.

2025-06-27.name: Eiga Sore Ike! Anpanman: Chapon no Hero!
Lupin the IIIrd the Movie: Fujimi no Ketsuzoku
Virgin Punk
2025-06-27.desc:
The year is 2099. With the development of medical artificial human body technology "Somadia," humans are able to overcome all injuries and illnesses. However, with the development of Somadia, crimes that misuse this technology are also on the rise. Somadia have physical abilities that far exceed those of a living body, and by illegally modifying them, they can be misused for crimes. In order to deal with such Somadia crimes, the government has created the bounty hunter system. Civilians who are registered as bounty hunters are allowed to kill Somadia criminals designated by the police and can receive large amounts of money in return. In this world, Ubu Shinsui makes a living as a bounty hunter, hunting down criminals. But one day, when she returns home from work, she finds her sworn enemy, Mr. Elegance, there - and her fate begins to go awry.

Source: ANN

2025-06-28.name: Guimi Zhi Zhu
2025-06-28.desc:
With the rising tide of steam power and machinery, who can come close to being a Beyonder? Shrouded in the fog of history and darkness, who or what is the lurking evil that murmurs into our ears?

Waking up to be faced with a string of mysteries, Zhou Mingrui finds himself transmigrated as Klein Moretti in an alternate Victorian era world where he sees a world filled with machinery, cannons, dreadnoughts, airships, difference machines, as well as Potions, Divination, Hexes, Tarot Cards, Sealed Artifacts...

The Light continues to shine but mystery has never gone far. Follow Klein as he finds himself entangled with the Churches of the world—both orthodox and unorthodox—while he slowly develops newfound powers thanks to the Beyonder potions.

Like the corresponding tarot card, The Fool, which is numbered 0—a number of unlimited potential—this is the legend of "The Fool."

(Source: Webnovel)

Source: MAL

2025-06-28.name: Onmyou Kaiten Re:Verse
2025-06-28.desc:
Narihira Takeru is a delinquent who often thinks about Tsukimiya, the girl who appears in his dreams. After an unexpected accident, Takeru finds himself in a parallel universe, and the world that Tsukimiya lives in. When Takeru and Tsukimiya are slain by a monster, he awakens again and realizes he has leapt through time. Now, Takeru must train with Abe Seimei to fight for Tsukimiya's life!

Source: Crunchyroll

Note: The first two episodes received an advance release on Fuji TV's YouTube channel on 28 June 2025. The regular TV broadcast started on 3 July 2025.

2025-06-28.name: Takopii no Genzai
2025-06-28.desc:
Takopii travels from his home of Happy Planet to spread happiness across Earth, but meets the unsmiling Shizuka upon landing. Her friends at school and home life seem to be the source of her somber expression and the pure-hearted Takopii is determined to change things for the better! But what truths await him when the curtains rise in this shocking drama?!

Source: Manga Plus

Note: The first episode received an early screening at a special event on 20 May 2025 at Grand Cinema Sunshine Ikebukuro in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on 28 June 2025.

2025-06-29.name: Koujo Denka no Kateikyoushi
2025-06-29.desc:
* Based on a fantasy light novel series written by Nanano Riku and illustrated by Cura.

After failing the final exam for his dream job at the royal court, promising young sorcerer Allen wants nothing more than to retreat to a simple life in the countryside. Unfortunately for him, he can't even afford the train fare! His only solution is to get a job, but his one lead is anything but modest—Duke Howard, one of the kingdom's most powerful nobles, needs a private tutor for his daughter Tina. Despite her academic brilliance, Tina is incapable of casting even a single spell. To make matters worse, entrance exams for the prestigious Royal Academy are fast approaching, and magical aptitude is mandatory! Can Allen use his unique brand of spellcasting to help Tina overcome her magical impairment, a mystery that not even the kingdom's finest sorcerers have been able to solve? And does her father, the duke, even want him to?

Source: J-Novel Club
